A Chlora hurried into the caves beneath the Tree of Life, searching for her daughter. A bright glare emitted from a cavern that had been dark as long as any of them could remember. Breathing heavily, she crept down the passage and peered around the corner. A small figure knelt over a pool of water, gazing into it. She wasn't moving at all.

"Mei!" Shouted the Chlora, rushing into the cavern and towards her daughter. She had been so worried. Ever since that other girl had went off following the soldiers she had been terrified her only daughter would go running off on an adventure and disappear somewhere. It had been a stroke of luck that someone had seen her heading into the caves, or she might have been lost. Rushing to embrace her daughter, she covered half the distance in what seemed like hours but was actually just seconds. Then, in one motion, the figure turned to face her.

She froze. It was her daughter's face, mostly, but the eyes.... THE EYES!!!!

Gazing into the thing's eye sockets she gazed into her own face. Reflected there perfectly, every detail. She was aware, vaguely, that she had stopped and stood still, muscles relaxed. But her mind was elsewhere. It was turned inwards, focused on herself. And something else was looking into her too.

"What-what are you?" She managed.

The thing spoke carefully, as if unused to speech.

*I ... aaaaammmmm ... Meiiiiiii*.

*I ... seeeeee ... youuuuuuu*.

*****

The Chlora were all busy discussing the portal that had opened. None spared a thought to a mother carrying her daughter in the other direction. Back to their home, it was assumed.

******
